selection.basis: The X-LAB AD8 candidate has an exact official mainland R7170 Di2 / Branta C50 TEAM build and dated CNY 26,980 list price, but no observed mainland seller price. A current matching seller listing could close one purchase-comparison gap.

target.model: X-LAB AD8 R7170 Di2 / Branta C50 TEAM complete bike
target.expected_basis: A current exact mainland seller page for the same R7170 Di2 / Branta C50 TEAM complete-bike package with a published CNY amount and visible SKU/package and purchase qualifications. Preserve the CNY 26,980 official list price separately.

research_route.action: Run one focused public search for an exact current X-LAB AD8 R7170 Di2 / Branta C50 TEAM seller listing. Open the first exact public seller detail page once to verify package, amount, date and conditions.
research_route.stop_rule: Stop after the first decisive exact seller page or after the focused search yields no exact matching package. Exclude the known Taobao 105 electronic / steel-spoke carbon-wheel standard build because it is a different package. Do not use account-only checkout, contact sellers, open unrelated trims, or cross login, CAPTCHA or verification.

Do not transfer the known CNY 21,980 Taobao price for the distinct standard/105-electronic build or any custom owner build to the preferred official configuration.
If no exact matching listing is readable, keep observed_price absent and document a blocked/no-result attempt with a clear retrigger condition.
